description_en: Returns the information of a job instance, allowing you to view its status and progress
description_zh: 返回任务实例的信息，可以查看任务实例的状态和进度
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 get-job-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --job-id 92583 --job-instance-id 1685883418 --namespace-source schedulerx --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetJobInstance

parameters.help_en: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间id，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can obtain the application ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 应用id，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，在控制台的任务管理页面中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party
parameters.help_zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source
